plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's depth and power. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.

summaryDeep:
There is a strong, productive potential in the energy between you, and it switches on when you engage it well.

This person can activate your drive and meet your intensity, but the power here works best when you aim it consciously rather than letting it run hot on its own. The charge is more manageable than in the hard contacts, the kind that builds real momentum when you use it and stays workable when you do not.

When this works, this person makes you bolder and more effective. They match your energy, back your pursuits, and help you act on what you want with more force than you would muster alone. The attraction can be strong without being destabilizing, the drive shared without becoming a contest. The more deliberately you point the energy at something real, the more it tends to give.

Where it falls flat is leaving the power idle, or letting the intensity simmer into friction instead of action. You may feel the charge and never quite channel it, so the potential stays unused or leaks out as low-grade tension.

Aim the energy on purpose, and keep it pointed at what you actually want. This one turns from charged to genuinely powerful when you put the intensity to work rather than letting it work on you.
